summary: End-to-end frontend testing of the Quotation Multi-Company & Multi-Currency feature. Admin login (admin/admin123) worked. On Company Settings → 'Selling Companies' card: created 'TEST TestCo Exports' with address, GST 09TESTCO1234Z1, email, phone, bank details and uploaded a small PNG logo via sc-logo-upload — logo preview rendered in the modal and the saved row appeared in the table. Editing the company (phone changed to +91-8888877777) persisted. On New Quotation modal: qtn-company-select correctly shows '— Main Company (AMREST ELECTRICALS LIMITED) —' + 'TEST TestCo Exports'; qtn-currency shows 'INR (₹)' and 'USD ($)'; qtn-exchange-rate appears only when USD is selected; qtn-usd-note correctly switches between 'PDF shows USD: Grand Total ≈ $117.29 @ 1 USD = ₹83.5' and 'No exchange rate set — entered rates are treated as USD on the PDF'. Per-company numbering WORKS: TestCo got QTN-2026-001, QTN-2026-002, QTN-2026-003, QTN-2026-004 while Main Company's next number was QTN-2026-021 (independent sequences). List renders the quot-company-<id> badge with 'TEST TestCo ' and a 'USD' badge on USD quotations. A4 Preview iframe loads for both main-company and TestCo quotations; Bank Details box with 'TEST HDFC / A/c 1234567890 / IFSC HDFC0001234' is rendered. For the USD quotation with exchangeRate=83.5, Rate=$99.40, Sub Total=$99.40, Tax (GST)=$17.89, Grand Total=$117.29, and the blue 'All amounts in USD ($) · Converted at 1 USD = ₹83.5' note are all correct. For the no-rate USD quotation, '$100.00' is shown and the 'All amounts in USD ($)' note appears without a Converted suffix (correct). Main-company regression preview shows AMREST branding, ₹ amounts, and no TestCo leakage. Persistence: after full page reload + re-login, all 4 TestCo quotations and the TestCo selling company remain. HOWEVER a CRITICAL BUG was found in the PDF header: for TestCo quotations the header still renders 'AMREST ELECTRICALS LIMITED', the AMREST address, GST 09AARCA0588P1ZR, AMREST email, the AMREST logo and the AMREST watermark — the Selling Company's name/logo/GST/contact never appear. Root cause: docBodyHtml() in /app/frontend/src/lib/utils.ts resolves an active Document Format for 'Quotation' from settings.documentFormats and does `format?.companyName || settings.name`, `format?.logoUrl || settings.logoUrl`, `format?.address || settings.address`, `format?.gstNo || settings.gst`, `format?.contactDetails || …`, `format?.watermark`, which take precedence over the effSettings override set in buildQuotationHTML in Quotations.tsx (lines 304–313). Only the inline body (Bank Details, item table, amounts) uses the override, which is why Bank Details DO show TEST HDFC but the header still shows AMREST. Bank Details for TestCo come from the inline `comp.bankDetails` block, not from the header pipeline.

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL: For a quotation whose companyId is a selling company, the PDF header still shows the main company's name/logo/address/GST/contact/watermark because docBodyHtml prefers settings.documentFormats[active].{companyName,logoUrl,address,gstNo,contactDetails,watermark} over the top-level settings fields that buildQuotationHTML overrides via effSettings.

design_issues.screen: Quotation Preview header for Selling Company
issues: Even when the fix lands for name/logo/GST, the AMREST watermark will still appear because format?.watermark is used directly — override it to '' (or to the selling company name) when a company is set.

In the header the contact line falls back to '${settings.email} | ${settings.phone}'. For a selling company with no email the preview showed 'GST: 09TESTCO1234Z1 | ...' with an email cut-off; make sure email/phone falls back correctly on the override path.

Row 'Logo' column renders fileDisplayUrl(c.logo) — in my test the preview thumbnail appeared blank in the row even though the modal preview rendered. Likely because the img needs the token query string and the row's img had the token appended (fileDisplayUrl handles it) — worth a visual check that uploaded logos actually render in the row (not just as the uploaded data URL inside the modal).

action_items: Fix docBodyHtml in /app/frontend/src/lib/utils.ts (or buildQuotationHTML in /app/frontend/src/pages/Quotations.tsx) so that when a selling company is used, its name/logo/address/gst/contact override the Document Format's header fields. Simplest fix: in buildQuotationHTML, when `comp` is set, build the header HTML inline instead of relying on professionalDocument(effSettings,…), OR pass a flag like `skipFormatHeader:true` down to docBodyHtml that forces header fields to come from the passed settings (ignoring documentFormats). The watermark should also be suppressed/overridden for selling-company quotations.
Verify selling-company logo renders in the Settings table row (not only in the modal preview).

Consider also overriding format.bankDetails when a selling company is set — currently the body appends `comp.bankDetails` but if the Document Format also has bank details, a duplicate Bank Details box could print (skipFormatTerms suppresses only terms, not bankDetails/declaration/signature).
critical_code_review_comments: buildQuotationHTML (Quotations.tsx:301-330) builds effSettings but passes to professionalDocument→docBodyHtml which prefers format.* fields; the override is silently ignored for the header. Add a `headerOverride` option or route around docBodyHtml for selling-company quotations.

docBodyHtml in utils.ts:234 unconditionally appends format.signatureUrl, format.declaration, format.watermark, format.footerContent, format.bankDetails — these will leak the MAIN company's signature/declaration/watermark onto a TestCo quotation. Needs explicit suppression when a selling company is set.

Settings.tsx `SellingCompaniesCard.save` captures `form` in setDB closure; if `form.id === ''` it correctly treats as new and generates uid; good. But `log()` uses `form.id ? 'Updated' : 'Added'` BEFORE id is assigned — the message shows 'Added' always even for the first save, which is actually correct here. Fine.

`companyNumber(companyId)` filters by `q.companyId || ''` — correct for main-company (empty string). nextNumber() uses the generic 'QTN' prefix; because the series is per-company, two companies will collide on QTN-2026-001 (same text, different owners). That's by design per requirements but worth noting it may confuse Reports/Logs that assume quotation numbers are unique.

rca of the issue: docBodyHtml (utils.ts) looks up an active Document Format whose documentType normalizes to 'quotation' and uses format.companyName/logoUrl/address/gstNo/contactDetails/watermark as the primary values (OR'd with top-level settings). buildQuotationHTML overrides only the top-level settings (name/address/gst/email/phone/logoUrl) via effSettings but does NOT override format.*, so the Document Format's main-company branding wins. Fix options: (a) pass a `forceSettingsHeader=true` option through professionalDocument→docBodyHtml which bypasses the format lookup when a selling company is used, OR (b) construct the TestCo quotation's header HTML directly in Quotations.tsx (not via professionalDocument). Reproduction: Settings → Add Company TestCo → New Quotation with company=TestCo, Save → open preview → header shows AMREST not TestCo. Expected: TestCo name/logo/GST on header.
